source: Make Me a Hanzi (https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi) graphics.txt stroke medians, derived from the fonts AR PL KaitiM GB and AR PL UKai, copyright Arphic Technology Co., Ltd.
licence: Arphic Public License, ARPHICPL.TXT (in this folder, unaltered)
changes: Changed by LineType in October 2026: the medians scaled and flipped into the pad (y down) and rounded to whole units; the six basic strokes (一丨丶丿亅乙) moved to the middle of the box. Only the characters LineType teaches.
format: Each character is a list of strokes in writing order; each stroke is a flat list of x, y points along its centre line (x0, y0, x1, y1, ...), in a 480 x 560 pad with the character in a box from about (65, 70) to (415, 420), y pointing down.
